import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int gcd(int a, int b) {
        return b == 0 ? a : gcd(b, a % b);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int x = scanner.nextInt();
        int y = scanner.nextInt();
        int limit = scanner.nextInt();

        double MAX = 1e9;
        double B = (double) x / y;
        int answer1 = 0, answer2 = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= limit; i++) {
            long bLong = (long) x * i / y;
            int b = (int) bLong;
            double A = (double) b / i;
            double A1 = (double) Math.abs(b - 1) / i;
            double A2 = (double) (b + 1) / i;

            if (Math.abs(B - A) < MAX) {
                answer1 = b;
                answer2 = i;
                MAX = Math.abs(B - A);
            }
            if (Math.abs(B - A1) < MAX) {
                answer1 = Math.abs(b - 1);
                answer2 = i;
                MAX = Math.abs(B - A1);
            }
            if (Math.abs(B - A2) < MAX) {
                answer1 = b + 1;
                answer2 = i;
                MAX = Math.abs(B - A2);
            }
        }

        if (Math.abs(1.0 - B) <= (Math.abs((double) answer1 / answer2 - B)) + 1e-9) {
            answer1 = 1;
            answer2 = 1;
        }

        int gcd = gcd(answer1, answer2);
        System.out.println((answer1 / gcd) + "/" + (answer2 / gcd));
    }
}
